description: ru - pista ciclabile is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by g3w-suite.comune.capannori.lu.it. Strategic Plan for Cycling Mobility approved by Resolution G.C.301 of 30/12/2013, integrated with routes proposed during the participatory process of the General Variant to the R.U. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "ru - cycle path" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include open data. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
